description:
Powerful and Customizable Motor Options: With motor options of 48V 350W, 500W, 750W, 1000W brushless geared hub motors, this product offers a range of power levels to suit different riding preferences and needs. Riders can choose the motor that best matches their desired performance, whether it's for a more leisurely ride or an exhilarating experience with higher speeds and stronger acceleration.

Long-Lasting Battery for Extended Rides:Equipped with a 48V 13AH/17.5 AH lithium-ion battery, this product ensures long-lasting power for extended rides. Riders can enjoy a range of 40-60 miles (65-95km) in PAS mode, providing the flexibility to explore various terrains and go the distance without worrying about running out of battery.

Versatile and Informative Display: The multifunctional big screen LCD display provides riders with essential information and controls at their fingertips. It offers clear visibility of speed, distance, battery level, and other important data, allowing riders to monitor their ride and make informed decisions. The display also allows for easy customization and adjustment of various settings.

Durable and Lightweight Aluminum Frame: Constructed with a 6061 aluminum alloy frame, this product combines durability and lightweight design. The frame ensures strength and stability while keeping the overall weight of the bike manageable. It provides a reliable platform for comfortable and agile rides, contributing to an enjoyable riding experience.

Responsive Suspension Fork:The aluminum alloy suspension fork on this product delivers a responsive and smooth ride. It absorbs shocks and vibrations from uneven terrain, providing riders with enhanced comfort and control. The suspension fork enables riders to navigate bumpy roads and trails with confidence, making the overall riding experience more enjoyable.

Reliable and Efficient Braking System: Featuring hydraulic disc brakes, this product ensures reliable and efficient braking performance. The hydraulic disc brakes provide strong and consistent stopping power, even in wet or muddy conditions. Riders can rely on these brakes for precise and controlled stopping, enhancing safety and instilling confidence during rides.

Convenient Throttle Control: With a twist throttle control, this product offers convenient and intuitive acceleration. Riders can easily control their speed with a simple twist of the throttle, making it effortless to adjust the pace to match the terrain or riding conditions. The twist throttle provides quick bursts of power and smooth acceleration for an enjoyable and dynamic riding experience.

Exceptional Traction with Fat Tires:Equipped with 26"*4.0" fat tires, this product ensures exceptional traction on various surfaces. The fat tires provide stability and grip, allowing riders to confidently tackle different terrains such as sand, snow, or gravel. The enhanced traction contributes to a smooth and controlled ride, ensuring safety and stability even in challenging riding conditions.

Easy to Assemble: This e-bike comes 85% pre-assembled. A video guide is available in the product page. Comes with a rear rack and mudguards

Professional Customer Service: 1-year warranty for battery, charger, motor and controller. If you run into any trouble with our bikes, pls contact us, we’ll reply your message within 24 hours. Pls keep the original bike box for 30 days for possible returns
